description: Source code for the AdditionalSalary document in ERPNext payroll module, including class definition, validation methods, and a function to retrieve additional salaries.

classes.name: AdditionalSalary
classes.description: Represents an additional salary record with validation, submission, cancellation, and calculation methods.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions when the additional salary record is submitted, updating related advances and referrals.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions when the record is canceled, reverting related updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the record before saving.

methods.name: validate_salary_structure
methods.description: Ensures a salary structure is assigned to the employee.

methods.name: validate_recurring_additional_salary_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping recurring additional salary entries for the same component and period.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates date fields against employee's joining and relieving dates.

methods.name: validate_employee_referral
methods.description: Validates the employee referral details for bonus eligibility.

methods.name: update_return_amount_in_employee_advance
methods.description: Updates the return amount in Employee Advance records based on this salary.

methods.name: update_employee_referral
methods.description: Updates the referral payment status, especially on cancellation.

methods.name: get_amount
methods.description: Calculates the salary amount for a given period based on the salary record.
